payload.core_mechanism_summary: Brute-force search over all O(n^2) possible character swaps in the first string, using difference sets to verify consistency with other strings.
payload.rationale: Iterates over all pairs (i,j), swaps characters in s[0], checks if all other strings can be obtained via one swap from the candidate, reverting on failure. This matches complete search with backtracking-like trial and revert.
